name: AstroCarto Astrocartography Chart
description: Generate an astrocartography chart in Chrome, save local profiles, and check selected cities against planetary lines.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src https://astrocarto.net; img-src 'self' data: https://*.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://*.openstreetmap.org
